sections.heading: Your countries visited map, built for you
body: You do not tick countries off a list. Dawarich reads your location history and counts the countries and cities you were in, for your whole history, for each year and for each month.
Click a countries or cities count to see the full list of places, each with a link to that part of the map. Import years of Google Timeline data and your map of visited countries fills in at once.

sections.heading: Years, months and single days
body: The All Time view shows one card per year, with its distance, a map of its routes, its months and its countries and cities. Pick a year to see distance month by month and a calendar where every day is coloured by the country you were in.

A country timeline shows how many days you spent in each country that year, and a distance race compares this year with the last one. Calendar country colours and the country timeline are part of Pro and self-hosted Dawarich.

sections.heading: Where the countries come from
body: Countries and cities come from reverse geocoding: turning coordinates into place names. Dawarich Cloud does this for you. A self-hosted instance needs a geocoding service configured; until then, distances and active days still work but countries stay empty.

sections.heading: Share a month
body: Any month can be shared through a public link that expires after an hour, a day, a week or a month. People you send it to see that month's statistics without an account, and nothing else. On Dawarich Cloud, sharing statistics is part of the Pro plan.

faqs.q: How does Dawarich know which countries I visited?
faqs.a: From the points in your location history. Each point is matched to a country and city by reverse geocoding, and each place is counted once per period.

faqs.q: Can I add the trips I took before using Dawarich?
faqs.a: Yes. Import your Google Timeline, Google Photos location data, GPX, FIT and other files, and those years appear in your statistics and on your map of visited countries.

faqs.q: Can I count how many days I spent in each country?
faqs.a: Yes. The yearly country timeline shows days per country, and the [Tax Residency Day Counter](/tax-residency/) adds stay periods and a 183-day flag.

faqs.q: How often are the statistics updated?
faqs.a: In the background after new points or imports arrive, and every hour. You can also recalculate them with Update stats on the Insights page.
Only you, unless you share a month with a public link. Dawarich does not sell or share your location data.
